title: Development of a bioluminescent AML-PDX mouse model for CAR T cell therapy
author: Safont, Leitch, et al.
materials: cryopreserved PDX cells from mouse spleen

steps.title: Prepare FACS buffer
steps.instruction: In a sterile container combine 10 mL fetal bovine serum (5 % v/v), 117 mg EDTA (2 mM), 200 mg sodium azide (0.1 % w/v) with 190 mL 1× PBS to a final volume of 200 mL; store at 4 °C for up to 3 months.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL FBS to the container.
Add 117 mg EDTA and mix until dissolved.
Add 190 mL 1× PBS and bring the total volume to 200 mL.

steps.title: Prepare complete RPMI‑1640 medium
steps.instruction: To 440 mL RPMI‑1640 add 5 mL L‑Glutamine (200 mM) to reach 2 mM, 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (100×) for 5 % final, and 50 mL fetal bovine serum for 10 % final; bring the volume to 500 mL, mix, and store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

substeps.instruction: Measure 440 mL RPMI‑1640 into a sterile bottle.
Add 5 mL L‑Glutamine (200 mM) – final 2 mM.
Add 50 mL fetal bovine serum – final 10 %.
Adjust volume to 500 mL with RPMI‑1640 if needed.
Mix gently, label, and store at 4 °C (max 1 month).

steps.title: Prepare transduction medium (fresh)
steps.instruction: Immediately before transduction, mix 280 µL RPMI‑1640 complete medium, 1.6 µL polybrene (1 mg/mL) to obtain 8 µg/mL, and 120 µL RediFect Red‑FLuc‑GFP (MOI 3) for a total of 400 µL; keep on ice and handle in a BSL‑2 lentivirus‑approved bench.

substeps.instruction: In a chilled tube add 280 µL RPMI‑1640 complete medium.
Add 1.6 µL polybrene (1 mg/mL) – final 8 µg/mL.
Mix gently to a final volume of 400 µL.
Keep the mixture on ice and use immediately for transducing 4 × 10⁵ AML‑PDX cells across four 96‑well plate wells.
